title: Tender guarantees and insurance: documents and acceptance checks
excerpt: For tenders in Moldova: requested form, documents, amount and validity. Check procedure requirements before submitting a bid.

seo.title: Tender guarantees in Moldova: preparation | ING Broker
seo.description: Prepare a bid-guarantee review: tender requirements, accepted form, parties, amount, currency, validity, wording and final-document checks.
seo.keywords: tender guarantee Moldova, bid guarantee, tender participation, guarantee documents, guarantee validity

content:
A tender participation guarantee and company-property insurance serve different purposes. For a Moldovan company, assessment starts with the procedure documents: who requests a guarantee, in which form, for which obligations and dates. A commercial guarantee-insurance presentation does not establish acceptance in a particular tender.

This material helps managers, procurement staff and accountants prepare checks. It determines no policy admissibility, interprets no procedure and confirms no issuance by ING Broker. Clarify accepted form with the beneficiary and competent specialists before incurring costs or submitting a bid.

Bid guarantees and performance guarantees differ

A bid guarantee relates to participation. A performance guarantee concerns different contractual obligations at a later stage following award. Names are not interchangeable. A document prepared for execution should not be assumed suitable for participation, or vice versa.

INTACT publicly presents both categories in Moldova as distinct products. That is an example of a local insurer's presentation, not general acceptance by every tender. Compare the requested document with actual proposed wording and clarify differences in title, duties and intended stage.

Start with the procedure file rather than price

Prepare the procedure reference, relevant documentation and later published clarifications. Record beneficiary, purchase subject and the company's file coordinator. Keep the version used for assessment. Missing updated annexes can lead to comparison against requirements no longer applying.

Extract form, amount, currency, duration and model wording into a sheet. Mark unclear information as a question. Do not fill gaps from memory or automatically copy a previous tender's requirements. Similar procedures may use different documents and deadlines.

Who confirms that the form is accepted?

Separate two confirmations: what the beneficiary accepts, and what the provider can issue after reviewing the company and request. A provider's guarantee-product page does not resolve beneficiary acceptance or mean an individual application has been approved.

For unclear requirements, use the procedure's clarification mechanism with procurement or legal support. This article is not evidence of admissibility. Keep replies and check that they concern the intended form, issuer and wording rather than guarantees in general.

For one procedure, keep the requirement's exact document location beside the proposed response. Mark whether a reply concerns beneficiary acceptance or provider issuance. These are separate decisions. An answer about one must not be presented to colleagues as confirmation of both.

Check names and roles

Identify participant, beneficiary and any joint-bid members accurately. Compare names and identifiers with the proposed instrument. For a joint submission, ask whose obligations and entities must be identified. Do not assume naming one company resolves every arrangement.

Record who requests issuance, pays costs and signs company documents. Disclose changes in management or participation structure before finalization. Accurate information is not a secondary formality; it establishes whether the document concerns the actual parties and procedure.

For joint participation, make the party list visible and seek an explanation of the intended scope. This organizational example does not determine legal acceptability. It helps ensure the actual participants, amounts and dates are reviewed before anyone declares the file ready for submission.

Read amount and currency from actual requirements

A percentage found online is not a universal rule. Check the calculation basis, required amount, currency and required notation. If bidding for specific lots, clarify the information for that participation. Do not infer one amount for every combination of lots.

Before confirmation, compare figures in the application, quotation and final document. Request correction even for seemingly small differences. Recheck after procedure amendments. A prepared instrument does not update itself following later published changes.

When a clarification changes dates or wording, preserve the previous version and identify which request needs updating. A draft's attractive cost does not resolve obsolete inputs. Check the final instrument again rather than assuming earlier review automatically applies.

Build a complete timeline

Record submission deadline, required validity and any extension requirements. Distinguish issuance date, effective date and expiry. An apparently adequate duration may still have an unsuitable beginning or wording. Review the calendar as a whole instead of checking only total days.

Ask early how modifications are requested and which records they need. Do not promise colleagues issuance or extension within a fixed number of hours without confirmation. Allow time for provider assessment, wording checks and clarification. Applying on the last day does not make assessment a formality with a guaranteed outcome.

Read the obligations and circumstances

Check participant obligations and conditions for a beneficiary demand. Ask for explanation of unfamiliar terms. Two documents with the same amount do not necessarily work identically. Wording, records and procedures matter despite similar commercial names.

Separate procedure duties from the company's relationship with the issuer. Ask which declarations the company signs, what information is required and what obligations may follow payment to a beneficiary. A guarantee is not money without responsibility for the applicant. Review commitments with appropriate support.

Company information for assessment

Start with company identification, procedure details and the provider's requested records. Financial position, similar-contract experience and representation documents may matter. This article does not establish the exact list. Request written requirements and check that the documents are up to date before sending.

For preliminary discussion, explain activity and participation clearly. Do not send passwords, unnecessary statement details or personal files through a public form. Necessary sensitive records use an agreed channel. Confirm which version was reviewed so later comments concern the same information.

Compare cost without losing conditions

A premium or instrument fee should not be compared separately from form, sum and duration. Request cost and conditions for modification, extension or cancellation where possible. A published internet amount is not your application's price. An offer depends on provider assessment and requested documents.

Compare on the same basis, marking confirmations, differences and missing answers. A lower fee does not compensate for beneficiary rejection. Equally, the most expensive option is not automatically the best. Justify choice by requirements and obligations rather than price alone.

An organizational example without invented figures

A hypothetical installation firm in Chișinău prepares a works tender. Procurement gathers model wording and clarifications, accounting prepares requested financial information and management checks representation. This is not a real client or confirmation that a particular instrument will be accepted.

The team finds an expiry date differing from the latest clarification. Before comparing prices, it corrects the request and seeks review against the same version. This avoids a cost discussion hiding a subject mismatch. The example establishes no issuance time, coverage condition or legal solution.

Use columns for requirement, its source, provider reply, supporting document and follow-up owner. Missing answers should say to confirm, not included. Give the submitting colleague the checked file and change list instead of several identically named files with conflicting dates.

Final checks before bid submission

  • Correct procedure and lots.
  • Beneficiary and participant matching requirements.
  • Instrument form clarified for this procedure.
  • Amount, currency and calculation basis checked.
  • Start and expiry matching the required calendar.
  • Final wording compared with model and clarifications.
  • Signed documents matching reviewed versions, not drafts.
  • Transmission and receipt confirmation arrangements established.

Assign a final checker and someone able to independently verify key information. Keep the checklist with the file. This does not certify legal admissibility, but helps prevent version, identity and calendar errors discovered too late.

When the procedure or participation changes

Notify reviewers of changed deadlines, subject or participants. Do not edit an issued document yourself or assume verbal clarification replaces required form. Ask about effects before using it. Keep the old version and confirmation concerning the new one.

After the stage ends, ask about the instrument and remaining obligations. Submission completion does not automatically end every company responsibility. Track records and dates. For disputes or beneficiary demands, obtain appropriate legal and contractual assistance rather than conclusions from a policy name.

Frequently asked questions

Is any guarantee insurance accepted by any tender?

Do not assume it. Check accepted form and wording for the actual procedure. A local product presentation does not replace confirmation.

Can a performance guarantee replace a bid guarantee?

They concern different stages and obligations. Similar names do not make them interchangeable. Verify the needed instrument before issuance and submission.

How much does it cost and how long does issuance take?

Request assessment using procedure documents, company details, amount and period. No tariff or issuance deadline for every application is confirmed here.

What can the broker do?

Clarify information for arrangement possibilities and explain proposal differences if the service is available. It does not decide beneficiary admissibility or guarantee insurer acceptance.

Next step

Request a conversation with ING Broker to check assessment and intermediation possibilities. The broker explains options and arranges insurance. Risk acceptance, conditions and claims handling belong to the insurer under the contract. This article does not confirm product availability or coverage of an individual case.
